fullPassage: Science for All Microscopes have been an essential tool for science for over 400 years. If microscopes had not been invented, we might not have discovered bacteria or the microscopic structures of living organisms. In certain areas of the world, however, even basic light microscopes are not accessible due to their cost. It was the Foldscope that Manu Prakash and Jim Cybulski presented as a solution to the problem. The Foldscope, a paper microscope they invented, achieved powerful magnification, and cost less than a dollar in parts. “The idea has been to make science accessible to everybody,” said Prakash. While researching methods for identifying infectious diseases in Thailand in 2011, Prakash came across an expensive microscope that was meant for malaria testing but was unused. Malaria takes over half a million lives annually, so early diagnosis is crucial in preventing its spread. But then, why was the microscope sitting unused? Prakash found that there were multiple reasons. The microscope was bulky and awkward to transport, required training to operate, and was difficult to maintain. As it was a delicate and expensive instrument, even trained lab workers felt nervous about using it. Prakash began wondering. A cheap, strong microscope could save thousands of lives. After he returned to Stanford University, where he was a professor, he started to reflect on the idea. It was not until he met Jim Cybulski that his idea of an affordable and accessible microscope began to take shape. A graduate student at Stanford, Cybulski was looking for ways to apply his engineering background to make a difference in the real world. After hearing Prakash’s vision, Cybulski quickly recognized its potential and was eager to contribute. For a microscope to function properly, it must meet certain minimum requirements. These include an eyepiece, a tube through which the viewer looks, and a lens for magnification. The microscope must also have a component that can hold a specimen and move from side to side to explore different areas of the specimen. Furthermore, a mechanism to bring the specimen into focus, usually accomplished by moving it closer to or farther from the lens, is necessary. Finally, a light source is required to illuminate the specimen. An ideal microscope would be made with the best performing materials and mechanisms for each component. However, such a microscope would likely be enormously expensive. On the other hand, a cheap microscope may not be able to deliver high performance. Prakash and Cybulski experimented with various designs and materials in order to find a suitable compromise. While many manufacturers might have settled for a middle ground between these two extremes, Prakash and Cybulski were determined to create a microscope that was both inexpensive and high-performing, while remaining accessible to all. After drawing various designs on paper, Prakash and Cybulski realized that paper could be an excellent medium for their microscope. It was cheap, easy to cut and fold with precision, and widely available. They faced many challenges during their attempts to develop the perfect design. Ultimately, they settled on waterproof cardboard paper with a small glass ball lens and named their invention the Foldscope. The Foldscope provides a magnification of 140 times, making it capable of examining blood cells, bacteria, and single-celled organisms. It is incredibly portable, weighs just 8 grams, fits easily in a pocket, and requires no external power source. Moreover, the Foldscope is built to last, capable of surviving a three-story fall. Its usefulness is further enhanced by its compatibility with phone cameras, allowing users to take pictures and record images of the specimen. It is also possible to project a high-resolution image on a wall using the phone light. It is no surprise that over 1.8 million Foldscopes have been distributed in over 160 countries, making it an invaluable tool for scientists worldwide. The Foldscope has been utilized for various purposes beyond malaria diagnosis. In Nigeria, it has also been instrumental in detecting fake antimalarial drugs. The drugs are responsible for over 100,000 deaths annually in sub-Saharan Africa, mostly among children under five. When crushed into powder and examined under a Foldscope, real drugs appear as uniform particles, while fake drugs appear as mere powder. Furthermore, over 400 scientific papers have been published using Foldscope data, and around 1,200 projects are currently in progress in India. In the United States, Foldscope programs in public libraries have introduced many children to the wonders of science. If Prakash and Cybulski had given up on their idea of the Foldscope, these achievements could not have occurred. As billions of people lack access to health care and thousands of preventable deaths occur, science is playing a crucial role in finding solutions to these challenges. Tools like the Foldscope, which make science accessible to everyone, are becoming increasingly important.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: had not been inventing → had not been invented (가정법 과거완료 수동)
det.analysis:
① have been: 'Microscopes have been an essential tool for science for over 400 years'는 400년 넘게 '~해 왔다'라는 현재완료라 have been이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② had not been inventing → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'If microscopes ___, we might not have discovered bacteria'는 'If + 주어 + had p.p., 주어 + might have p.p.' 가정법 과거완료예요. 현미경은 '발명되는' 대상이므로 수동태 had not been invented(발명되지 않았더라면)가 되어야 해요. 능동 진행형 had not been inventing은 틀려요. ❌ ←정답

③ are not accessible: 'even basic light microscopes are not accessible'는 복수주어 microscopes에 맞는 복수동사 are라 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ they invented: 'a paper microscope they invented'는 microscope를 꾸미는 관계절(목적격 관계대명사 생략)이라 과거형 invented가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 가정법 과거완료 수동: If ~ had not been invented(발명되지 않았더라면).

det.analysis:

④ to function: 'For a microscope to function properly'는 'for + 목적어 + to부정사' 구조(to부정사의 의미상 주어)라 to function이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 전치사 After + 동명사: After hearing(들은 후에).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: drawn → drawing (전치사 After + 동명사)
det.analysis:
① to find: 'experimented with various designs ... in order to find a suitable compromise'는 '~하기 위해'라는 목적의 to부정사라 to find가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② might have settled: 'many manufacturers might have settled for a middle ground'는 '~했을지도 모른다'라는 과거 추측(조동사 + have + 과거분사)이라 might have settled가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ remaining: 'while remaining accessible to all'은 'while + 분사'(접속사를 남긴 분사구문)로, 능동의 의미라 현재분사 remaining이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ drawn → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'After ___ various designs on paper, Prakash and Cybulski realized'에서 After는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사가 와야 해요. '~을 그린 후에'라는 뜻이므로 drawing이 되어야 하고, 과거분사 drawn은 틀려요. ❌ ←정답

det.korean: unimportant → crucial: 조기 진단이 '매우 중요하다'
det.analysis:
① unused: 'an expensive microscope ... but was unused'는 고가의 현미경이 '사용되지 않고' 있었다는 뜻이라 unused가 적절해요. ✅ 올바름

② unimportant → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'Malaria takes over half a million lives annually, so early diagnosis is ___ in preventing its spread'에서 말라리아가 해마다 많은 목숨을 앗아가므로 조기 진단이 '매우 중요하다(crucial)'가 적절해요. '중요하지 않다(unimportant)'는 정반대예요. ❌ ←정답

③ bulky: 'The microscope was bulky and awkward to transport'는 현미경이 '부피가 커서' 옮기기 불편했다는 뜻이라 bulky가 적절해요. ✅ 올바름

④ difficult to maintain: 현미경이 '유지·관리하기 어려웠다'는 문맥에 적절해요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 많은 목숨을 앗아가므로 조기 진단은 crucial(매우 중요한) ↔ unimportant(중요하지 않은).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: expensive → inexpensive: 두 사람이 '저렴한' 현미경을 만들려 함
det.analysis:
① enormously expensive: 'such a microscope would likely be enormously expensive'는 이상적 현미경이 '엄청나게 비쌀' 것이라는 뜻이라 적절해요. ✅ 올바름

② high performance: 'a cheap microscope may not be able to deliver high performance'는 싼 현미경이 '높은 성능'을 못 낼 수 있다는 뜻이라 적절해요. ✅ 올바름

③ compromise: 'experimented ... in order to find a suitable compromise'는 두 극단 사이의 '절충안'을 찾았다는 뜻이라 적절해요. ✅ 올바름

④ expensive → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'determined to create a microscope that was both ___ and high-performing'에서 두 사람은 저렴하면서도 성능 좋은 현미경을 만들려 했어요. 따라서 '저렴한(inexpensive)'이 맞고, '비싼(expensive)'은 모두에게 접근 가능하게 하려는 목표와 정반대예요. ❌ ←정답
det.tip: 모두가 쓸 수 있는 현미경 → inexpensive(저렴한) ↔ expensive(비싼).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 to illuminate the specimen(표본을 비추기 위해)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① to magnify the final image(최종 이미지를 확대하기 위해): 확대는 렌즈(lens)의 역할이에요.

❌ ② to hold the glass slide(유리 슬라이드를 고정하기 위해): 표본을 고정하는 것은 다른 부품의 역할이에요.

❌ ③ to record the measured data(측정한 데이터를 기록하기 위해): 기록은 본문의 요건에 없어요.

✅ ④ to illuminate the specimen(표본을 비추기 위해): 'Finally, a light source is required ___'에서 '광원(light source)'이 필요한 이유는 표본을 '비추기 위해서'이므로 to illuminate the specimen이 적절해요. ← 정답
det.tip: a light source(광원)의 목적 = 표본을 비추는 것(illuminate).

det.korean: 글 전체가 전하려는 핵심.
det.analysis:
① 글은 저렴하고 휴대 가능한 종이 현미경 Foldscope가 어떻게 만들어졌고, 말라리아 진단·가짜 약 탐지·과학 교육 등에서 '모두가 과학에 접근'하게 했는지를 다루므로 주제로 적절해요. ← 정답

② 400년 현미경 발전사는 도입부 배경일 뿐이에요.

③ 말라리아의 경제적 영향은 글의 초점이 아니에요.

④ 스탠퍼드 공학 교육은 배경 정보일 뿐이에요.
det.tip: 마지막 문장 'Tools like the Foldscope, which make science accessible to everyone'이 주제를 압축해요.

ch: 모두가 과학에 접근할 수 있게 한 저렴한 현미경 Foldscope의 개발과 그 의의
400년에 걸친 광학 현미경 기술의 점진적 발전 과정
말라리아가 전 세계 공중 보건에 미치는 경제적 영향
스탠퍼드 대학교 공학 교육 과정의 우수성과 특징

questions.passage: In certain areas of the world, however, even basic light microscopes are not accessible due to their cost.  It was the Foldscope that Manu Prakash and Jim Cybulski presented as a solution to the problem.  The Foldscope, a paper microscope they invented, achieved powerful magnification, and cost less than a dollar in parts.  “The idea has been to make science accessible to everybody,” said Prakash.  While researching methods for identifying infectious diseases in Thailand in 2011, Prakash came across an expensive microscope that was meant for malaria testing but was unused.
questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 제목.
det.analysis:
✅ ① The Foldscope: A Paper Microscope for Everyone(폴드스코프: 모두를 위한 종이 현미경): 글은 저렴한 종이 현미경 Foldscope가 과학을 모두에게 접근 가능하게 했다는 내용이라 제목으로 가장 적절해요. ← 정답

❌ ② The Dangerous Spread of Malaria in Africa(아프리카에서의 위험한 말라리아 확산): 말라리아는 Foldscope의 활용 사례일 뿐이에요.

❌ ③ A Short History of Scientific Instruments(과학 기구의 짧은 역사): 과학 기구의 역사를 다루는 글이 아니에요.

❌ ④ Why Expensive Microscopes Are Always Better(비싼 현미경이 항상 더 나은 이유): 오히려 저렴한 현미경의 가치를 말하므로 반대예요.
det.tip: 핵심 소재 'Foldscope'와 'for everyone(모두를 위한)'을 담은 제목이 정답이에요.

ch: The Foldscope: A Paper Microscope for Everyone
The Dangerous Spread of Malaria in Africa
A Short History of Scientific Instruments
Why Expensive Microscopes Are Always Better

questions.passage: An ideal microscope would be made with the best performing materials and mechanisms for each component.  However, such a microscope would likely be enormously expensive.  On the other hand, a cheap microscope may not be able to deliver high performance.  Prakash and Cybulski experimented with various designs and materials in order to find a suitable compromise.  While many manufacturers might have settled for <u>a middle ground between these two extremes</u>, Prakash and Cybulski were determined to create a microscope that was both inexpensive and high-performing, while remaining accessible to all.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>a middle ground between these two extremes</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 밑줄 구절이 비유하는 '절충'의 의미.
det.analysis:
앞 문장들에서 '이상적이지만 매우 비싼 현미경'과 '싸지만 성능이 낮은 현미경'이라는 두 극단(two extremes)이 제시돼요. 'a middle ground'는 그 사이의 '절충점(타협)'을 뜻하는 비유예요.

❌ ① 두 회사의 합병: ground를 물리적 공간으로 오해한 함정이에요.

✅ ② 저렴함과 고성능이라는 두 극단 사이에서 적당히 타협한 중간 수준: 'middle ground between these two extremes'는 비싼 고성능과 싼 저성능 사이의 절충을 가리켜요. ← 정답

❌ ③ 평평한 중앙 받침대: 현미경 부품이 아니에요.

❌ ④ 공용 작업 공간: 물리적 장소가 아니라 '절충'을 뜻해요.
det.tip: two extremes = 비싼 고성능 vs 싼 저성능 → middle ground = 그 사이의 절충.

ch: 두 회사가 합병하여 만든 새로운 조직
저렴함과 고성능이라는 두 극단 사이에서 적당히 타협한 중간 수준
과학자들이 모여 토론하는 공용 작업 공간

questions.passage: After he returned to Stanford University, where he was a professor, he started to reflect on the idea.  It was not until he met Jim Cybulski that his idea of an affordable and accessible microscope began to take shape.  A graduate student at Stanford, Cybulski was looking for ways to apply his engineering background to make a difference in the real world.  After hearing Prakash’s vision, Cybulski quickly <u>recognized its potential</u> and was eager to contribute.  For a microscope to function properly, it must meet certain minimum requirements.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분에서 <u>its</u>가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: its가 가리키는 대상.
det.analysis:
밑줄 바로 앞에서 'After hearing Prakash's vision(Prakash의 비전을 들은 후)'이라고 했어요.

✅ ① Prakash가 제시한 비전: 'Cybulski quickly recognized its potential'의 its는 앞의 'Prakash's vision(저렴하고 접근 가능한 현미경 아이디어)'을 가리켜요. ← 정답

❌ ② Cybulski의 공학 배경: its의 주체가 아니라 Cybulski 자신의 능력이에요.

❌ ③ 스탠퍼드 연구 시설: 본문에서 its가 가리키는 대상이 아니에요.

❌ ④ 비싼 현미경의 성능: 문맥과 무관해요.
det.tip: its는 바로 앞의 'Prakash's vision(Prakash의 비전)'을 받는 대명사예요.

questions.passage: The Foldscope provides a magnification of 140 times, making it capable of examining blood cells, bacteria, and single-celled organisms.  It is incredibly portable, weighs just 8 grams, fits easily in a pocket, and requires no external power source.  Moreover, the Foldscope is built to last, capable of __________.  Its usefulness is further enhanced by its compatibility with phone cameras, allowing users to take pictures and record images of the specimen.  It is also possible to project a high-resolution image on a wall using the phone light.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 surviving a three-story fall(3층 높이에서 떨어져도 견디는)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① connecting to the internet easily(인터넷에 쉽게 연결되는): 인터넷 연결은 본문에 없어요.

❌ ② producing its own bright light(자체 밝은 빛을 내는): Foldscope는 외부 전원이 필요 없다고 했을 뿐 자체 발광하지 않아요.

❌ ③ scanning any printed text(인쇄된 글자를 스캔하는): 글자 스캔 기능은 없어요.

✅ ④ surviving a three-story fall(3층 높이에서 떨어져도 견디는): 'the Foldscope is built to last, capable of ___'에서 '오래가도록(견고하게) 만들어졌다'는 흐름이므로, '3층 높이에서 떨어져도 견디는'이 자연스러워요. ← 정답
det.tip: built to last(오래가도록 만들어진) → 떨어져도 견디는 내구성을 뜻해요.

questions.passage: Science for All __________ for over 400 years.  If microscopes had not been invented, we might not have discovered bacteria or the microscopic structures of living organisms.  In certain areas of the world, however, even basic light microscopes are not accessible due to their cost.  It was the Foldscope that Manu Prakash and Jim Cybulski presented as a solution to the problem.  The Foldscope, a paper microscope they invented, achieved powerful magnification, and cost less than a dollar in parts.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'현미경은 과학에 필수적인 도구였다.'

[조건]
(1) an, been, essential, for, have, Microscopes, science, tool 을 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (현재완료 have been을 사용할 것)

det.korean: 현미경은 과학에 필수적인 도구였다.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- Microscopes(주어): 현미경은
- have been(현재완료): ~이어 왔다
- an essential tool(보어): 필수적인 도구
- for science(전치사구): 과학에
→ 과거부터 지금까지 쭉 그래 왔음을 나타내므로 현재완료 have been을 써요. 주어가 복수(Microscopes)라 has가 아닌 have예요.
det.tip: 복수 주어 + 현재완료 → have been. '쭉 ~이어 왔다'.

questions.wa: Microscopes have been an essential tool for science
accept: Microscopes have been an essential tool for science

questions.passage: It was the Foldscope that Manu Prakash and Jim Cybulski presented as a solution to the problem. The Foldscope, a paper microscope they __________ (invent), achieved powerful magnification, and cost less than a dollar in parts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: '그들이 발명한 종이 현미경'이 되도록 invent를 변형.
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'a paper microscope they ___'은 microscope를 꾸미는 관계절(목적격 관계대명사 생략)이에요. 두 사람이 Foldscope를 '발명한' 것은 과거의 일이므로 invent의 과거형 invented를 써요.
det.tip: 과거의 일 → 과거형 invented. a microscope (that) they invented(그들이 발명한 현미경).

questions.passage: While researching methods for identifying infectious diseases in Thailand in 2011, Prakash came across an expensive microscope that was meant for malaria testing but was unused.  Malaria takes over half a million lives annually, so __________.  But then, why was the microscope sitting unused?  Prakash found that there were multiple reasons.  The microscope was bulky and awkward to transport, required training to operate, and was difficult to maintain.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'조기 진단은 말라리아 확산을 막는 데 매우 중요하다.'

[조건]
(1) crucial, diagnosis, early, in, is, its, preventing, spread 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것 (be crucial in + 동명사 구문을 사용할 것)

det.korean: 조기 진단은 말라리아 확산을 막는 데 매우 중요하다.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- early diagnosis(주어): 조기 진단은
- is crucial(동사 + 보어): 매우 중요하다
- in preventing its spread(전치사구, in + 동명사): 그것(말라리아)의 확산을 막는 데
→ 'be crucial in + 동명사(~하는 데 중요하다)' 구문이며, 전치사 in 뒤에 동명사 preventing이 와요. its는 앞의 malaria를 가리켜요.
det.tip: be crucial in + 동명사: is crucial in preventing(막는 데 중요하다).

questions.wa: early diagnosis is crucial in preventing its spread
accept: early diagnosis is crucial in preventing its spread

questions.passage: The Foldscope provides a magnification of 140 times, making it capable of examining blood cells, bacteria, and single-celled organisms.  It is incredibly portable, weighs just 8 grams, fits easily in a pocket, and requires no external power source.  Moreover, the Foldscope is built to last, capable of surviving a three-story fall.  __________, allowing users to take pictures and record images of the specimen.  It is also possible to project a high-resolution image on a wall using the phone light.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (정확히 11단어, 영어로)

'그 유용성은 휴대폰 카메라와의 호환성 덕분에 더욱 높아진다.'

[단어] by / cameras / compatibility / enhanced / further / is / its / Its / phone / usefulness / with

det.korean: 그 유용성은 휴대폰 카메라와의 호환성 덕분에 더욱 높아진다.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- Its usefulness(주어): 그 유용성은
- is further enhanced(동사, 수동태): 더욱 높아진다
- by its compatibility with phone cameras(전치사구): 휴대폰 카메라와의 호환성 덕분에
→ 수동태 'be + 과거분사(is enhanced)'에 by가 이어져 행위의 원인을 나타내요. further는 enhanced를 꾸미는 부사예요.
det.tip: 수동태 is enhanced + by ~ (~에 의해 높아진다). further enhanced(더욱 높아진).

questions.wa: Its usefulness is further enhanced by its compatibility with phone cameras
accept: Its usefulness is further enhanced by its compatibility with phone cameras

questions.passage: Furthermore, over 400 scientific papers have been published using Foldscope data, and around 1,200 projects are currently in progress in India.  In the United States, Foldscope programs in public libraries have introduced many children to the wonders of science.  If Prakash and Cybulski had given up on their idea of the Foldscope, these achievements could not have occurred.  As billions of people lack access to health care and thousands of preventable deaths occur, __________ in finding solutions to these challenges.  Tools like the Foldscope, which make science accessible to everyone, are becoming increasingly important.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'과학은 중요한 역할을 하고 있다.'

[조건]
(1) a, crucial, is, playing, role, science 를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (현재진행 is playing을 사용할 것)

det.korean: 과학은 중요한 역할을 하고 있다.
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- science(주어): 과학은
- is playing(동사, 현재진행): 하고 있다
- a crucial role(목적어): 중요한 역할을
→ 'play a role(역할을 하다)'을 현재진행형(be + V-ing)으로 써서 '지금 역할을 하고 있다'는 의미를 나타내요.
det.tip: play a role을 현재진행으로: is playing a crucial role(중요한 역할을 하고 있다).

questions.wa: science is playing a crucial role
accept: science is playing a crucial role
